summary: Sprint 6 (Admin auth) backend-only testing: 12/12 pytest cases passed against the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified /api/auth login/refresh/logout/me flows, generic-error uniformity, Bearer extraction, refresh-token ROTATION with old-token invalidation, logout invalidation, Argon2id hashing in admins collection, and security_logs coverage (login_success/login_fail/token_refresh/logout) with no plaintext password or token fields leaked.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers. Non-blocking for Sprint 6 but worth migrating.

cors_origins defaults to '*' in config (allow_credentials becomes False in that case). Acceptable for Sprint 6 (no cookies, Bearer transport), but before enabling any browser-based portal, explicit origins must be configured.

admin_password default 'AzurisDev@2026!' is baked into core/config.py as a Settings default. It is only used by the dev seed script (which refuses ENVIRONMENT=production), and no reset endpoint reads it — acceptable, but consider removing the default and requiring the env var explicitly to avoid any risk of a prod deploy inheriting the dev password if seed_admin were ever run.

In api/auth.login the login_fail security event carries the admin.uuid when the email exists but password fails, and None when the email is unknown. The HTTP response is correctly identical (generic 401), so no user-enumeration leak externally; just noting for internal log analysis.

logout(): if a refresh_token is provided but decodes with a different sub than the caller, we silently do nothing and still return 200 — correct behavior (idempotent, generic), but callers cannot distinguish this. Fine per spec.
test_credentials: admin@azuris.local / AzurisDev@2026! (SUPER_ADMIN), from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; re-seeded via `cd /app/backend && python -m scripts.seed_admin` before test run.
seed_data_creation: Re-ran scripts.seed_admin to guarantee the SUPER_ADMIN exists with the expected password_hash.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_sprint6_auth.py and validates the full JWT admin auth surface (login/refresh/rotation/logout/me + Argon2id hash + security_logs). It reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env and connects to MongoDB at mongodb://localhost:27017 DB=test_database for direct-store assertions. Sprint 6 is Bearer/JSON only — do NOT check for cookies or a login UI. Roles are enum values SUPER_ADMIN/ADMINISTRATOR/CONTENT_MANAGER/CUSTOMER_SERVICE. Generic 401 detail is 'Invalid credentials' for all login failures.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. (One initial test-authoring flake: access_token equality when refresh runs within the same second as login; fixed with a 1.1s sleep so iat differs. Not a product bug.)
